title: The Maple Street Neighbourhood Club
instructions: 这是为A1学习者设计的原创模拟听力与语法练习（非官方雅思测试，不涉及真实分数）。先听/读对话，注意 we / they + are、规则复数、my / your / his / her、have / has 的用法。然后完成8道听力题和8道语法题。听力题答案都能在原文中找到；填空题答案必须与原文完全一致，且不超过字数限制。中文解释帮助你理解，但题目和选项都是英文。
transcript:
Mia: Hello, Ben. This is our club room. We are new members.
Ben: Hi, Mia. Welcome! I am Ben. I have two keys. They are for you.
Mia: Thank you. Are they your keys?
Ben: No, they are not my keys. They are her keys. Her name is Lily. She has a big bag.
Mia: And who are they? Are they members too?
Ben: Yes, they are. They are Tom and Anna. They have three maps. Their maps are on the table.
Mia: My map is small. Your map is big.
Ben: Yes. We are a happy club. We have eight members.

grammar.title: we / they + are；规则复数；my / your / his / her；have / has
grammar.explanation:
先看意思：we是“我们”，they是“他们/她们/它们”。we和they后面用are，不用am或is。例如：We are new members. They are members too. 否定在are后加not：They are not my keys. 一般疑问把are放句首：Are they members? 回答：Yes, they are. / No, they are not.
规则复数：多数名词加-s，如key→keys, map→maps, member→members。
my / your / his / her 表示“我的/你的/他的/她的”，后面接名词：my keys, your map, his bag, her name。
have / has 表示“有”。I / you / we / they 用have；he / she / it 用has。例如：I have two keys. She has a big bag. They have three maps.
grammar.example: We are new members. They have three maps. She has a big bag.

questions.explanation: 主语they的一般疑问句把Are放句首。
主语she是第三人称单数，用has。
括号里是I，所以用my表示“我的”。
